title: LIAN LI O11 Dynamic EVO RGB Case Review: High-End Build Support and Cooling Options
summary: Review the LIAN LI O11D EVO RGB case, including GPU clearance, radiator support, storage options, cooling needs, and key buying tradeoffs.
body_markdown:
Planning a showcase gaming PC with room for premium components? The LIAN LI O11 Dynamic EVO RGB, model O11DERGBX, is a black ATX/Micro ATX mid-tower designed around expansive hardware support, flexible cooling, and a clear view of the build. Its steel, aluminum, and tempered-glass construction delivers a polished look, while graphics card clearance up to 455.7 mm accommodates many modern enthusiast GPUs. That spacious design comes with tradeoffs, including a large footprint and no included fans, so it is best suited to builders who are budgeting for a complete cooling setup.


## What is the LIAN LI O11 Dynamic EVO RGB?


The O11DERGBX supports EATX motherboards under 280 mm, along with ATX, Micro ATX, and Mini-ITX boards. Measuring 18.82 x 11.42 x 18.54 inches and weighing 37.92 pounds, it is built more as a spacious showcase chassis than as a small-form-factor case.


Two tempered-glass side panels highlight the installed components, and a bottom dust filter helps manage dust intake. The case does not include a power supply. Its front I/O features two USB 3.0 ports, one audio connection, and three buttons. Newegg lists the model as first listed on January 22, 2024.


## Which hardware and cooling configurations does it support?


Expansion room is a major reason to consider this case. It supports CPU coolers up to 167 mm tall, ATX power supplies shorter than 220 mm, and graphics cards up to 455.7 mm long. Before ordering, compare those limits with the exact dimensions of your CPU cooler, GPU, and power supply.


- Top radiator support: 360 mm, 420 mm, or 240 mm.
- Side radiator support: 360 mm, 280 mm, or 240 mm.
- Bottom radiator support: 360 mm, 280 mm, or 240 mm.
- Top, side, and bottom positions support up to three 120 mm or three 140 mm fans.
- Rear position supports one 120 mm fan.
- No fans are pre-installed, so the cooling budget must include additional fans.


## How much storage and component room does it provide?


The storage layout offers useful flexibility for a gaming or workstation build. The hard-drive cage holds two 3.5-inch HDDs or two 2.5-inch SSDs. The side fan bracket can hold two 3.5-inch drives or four 2.5-inch SSDs, while the area behind the motherboard tray supports two additional 2.5-inch SSDs.


Shoppers comparing it with a budget-oriented small-form-factor option such as the IN WIN CE685.FH300TB3 should first confirm that model's current dimensions, included power supply, drive bays, and cooling limits. The O11DERGBX is not a direct SFF alternative: its 18.82-inch height, 455.7 mm GPU allowance, and multi-position radiator support favor upgrade flexibility over a minimal desk footprint.


## What are the main pros and cons?


- **Pros:** Supports EATX under 280 mm, ATX, Micro ATX, and Mini-ITX motherboards.
- **Pros:** Provides up to 420 mm top radiator support and 455.7 mm of GPU clearance.
- **Pros:** Combines steel and aluminum construction with two tempered-glass side panels.
- **Cons:** No fans or power supply are included.
- **Cons:** Its 37.92-pound weight and large dimensions make it a poor fit for compact builds.


## Is the LIAN LI O11 Dynamic EVO RGB worth buying?


The[LIAN LI O11 Dynamic EVO RGB O11DERGBX](https://www.newegg.com/lian-li-atx-micro-atx-mid-tower-steel-aluminum-tempered-glass-cases-black-o11dergbx/p/2AM-000Z-000C0?utm_medium=content&utm_source=insider&utm_campaign=insider_article_geo_lian-li-o11d-evo-rgb-case-review) is a compelling pick for builders who want broad motherboard compatibility, long-GPU clearance, multiple radiator mounting options, and a glass-forward presentation. Its generous interior leaves plenty of room for a powerful custom system and future upgrades.


It is a weaker match for a low-cost small-form-factor build. Choose it when you need its expansion capacity and are ready to purchase case fans separately. If compact dimensions or a simpler budget build are the priority, verify the IN WIN CE685.FH300TB3 specifications directly before comparing overall value.


## What should buyers verify before ordering?


### Does the case include fans or a power supply?


No. The listed configuration includes no pre-installed fans and no power supply.


### Will a large graphics card fit?


The stated maximum GPU length is 455.7 mm. Confirm your graphics card's length, along with any clearance requirements created by front, side, or radiator installation.


### How many motherboard sizes are supported?


The case supports EATX boards under 280 mm, ATX, Micro ATX, and Mini-ITX.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### Which motherboard sizes are compatible with the LIAN LI O11D EVO RGB?


The case supports EATX motherboards under 280 mm wide, as well as standard ATX, Micro ATX, and Mini-ITX boards. Check your motherboard dimensions and connector placement before installation, especially when using an EATX board with side-mounted fans or radiators.


### Does the LIAN LI O11D EVO RGB include fans or a power supply?


No, the listed O11DERGBX configuration includes neither pre-installed case fans nor a power supply. Buyers should budget separately for compatible fans and a suitable ATX PSU, which must be shorter than 220 mm according to the stated clearance.


### Is the LIAN LI O11D EVO RGB good for high-end gaming hardware?


It is well suited to premium gaming builds because it supports graphics cards up to 455.7 mm long and CPU coolers up to 167 mm tall. Its spacious dual-chamber layout also provides room for multiple radiators, cable management, and future component upgrades.


### What cooling configurations does the case support?


The top, side, and bottom positions can accommodate radiators up to 420 mm or 360 mm depending on the location and configuration, while each main position supports up to three 120 mm or three 140 mm fans. Because no fans are included, buyers should plan an intake and exhaust layout before selecting their cooling hardware.


### What warranty and availability details should buyers verify?


LIAN LI lists a one-year warranty for the O11D EVO RGB, but warranty coverage can vary by region and seller. Availability, pricing, accessory bundles, and included mounting brackets may change, so confirm the retailer listing and the exact O11DERGBX configuration before ordering.
